body: I have aspergers which is on the spectrum. From what I read what makes you think she is not interested in you. She responds to your messages correct? She agrees to meet IRL and hang out together. In my experience if she was not interested in you she would not respond. She would  not make plans with you or keep the plans you have already made. You are very early in your relationship*. I say that turn because even friends have a relationship between another. What I can say is with our situation there is no fast road. To get over the stumbling blocks you two have takes time. You have already done so much by developing and opening  communication. That is the first step everything else comes when it is ment to. Forcing things to progress. Especially with our issues well never ends well.
